items.title: Legal site identity
items.missing_input: Confirm legal lot, title/PID and whether the retained GIS lead identifies it.
items.impact: A captured parcel lead or typed address does not establish the legal site for applicable rules.
items.next_action: Obtain title/legal parcel evidence and reconcile it with the retained lead.

items.title: Survey, existing buildings and placement
items.missing_input: Surveyed legal boundaries, front/rear lines, existing buildings, constraints and a proposed suite placement.
items.impact: Approximate parcel area cannot establish rear-yard area, occupied area, separation or available placement.
items.suggested_supplier: Owner, land surveyor and site designer
items.next_action: Supply a current survey and placement drawing with measurement bases.

items.title: Installed roof height and datum
